action:
Write the procedure that makes the shipped door usable, then correct every surface that now contradicts it.

WHERE, AND WHY THERE. gates-and-delegation.md is the only file in skills/ that names the dispatch door and its kinds, and it already owns the worker-class taxonomy that D3 and D7 speak in. Put the new section between the delegation contract and the judgment contract. Copy the four-move shape bee-reviewing's wave uses — who fans out, what each one gets and is denied, when synthesis is allowed, what the synthesis must run — because that is the nearest shipped procedure of the same kind. Copy the single-home clause from the goal-check judge tier section verbatim in spirit: name this section as the one home, and give every other surface a pointer, never a copy. AGENTS.md's Deep contracts list gains one clause naming the section; that is the whole AGENTS.md cost.

WHAT THE PROSE MUST CARRY. D1: the agent opens two or three lanes on its own judgment when a decision is both high-stakes AND ambiguous, and logs the reason at open time; the user may order lanes directly; a deadlocked convergence hands the human the dossier and never resolves itself. D5: pushback counts only when it names the specific missing context. D7: lanes GENERATE designs from one brief, hats CRITIQUE one request from fixed perspectives; neither replaces the other. And the rule that gives the checker its teeth: convergence RUNS bee blind check green BEFORE it logs the decision — no door forces that, so the prose is what forces it.

THREE LIMITS, STATED PLAINLY, NOT BURIED. The check proves provenance, never faithfulness (decision 79b5437b). Round two is outside the evidence chain: round-2 briefs differ per lane by construction, so the digest check, the recorded-brief re-lint and the citation check all cover round ONE only — the prose therefore requires the round-2 dispatch ids in the dossier's cross-critique section and says plainly what is not mechanically checked. And the tagged fence is a claim, not a proof: it matches the literal trimmed and ASCII-case-folded, and anyone can type it.

THE RUNNABILITY CONSTRAINT. bee blind check resolves each lane's dispatch id against .bee/logs/dispatch.jsonl. The shipped example dossier refuses in the main checkout because its ids are placeholders that never ran here. Say so: the check runs at the root whose log holds the run. A rule with no runnable example is a rule nobody follows.

TWO FALSE SURFACES TO FIX. The generated registry help for bee blind check still says the citation, brief-digest and read-diet checks 'are not part of this door yet'; all six checks ship. Correct that sentence — it is the only place it appears. And the knowledge concept at docs/knowledge/areas/advisor-protocol/blind-lanes-and-the-convergence-dossier.md still lists this slice under Open Gaps as decided-but-unbuilt; move what now ships into its shipped list, and leave in Open Gaps only what is still genuinely unbuilt.

NO SIZE CEILING. This repo forbids one, and none may be introduced. Match the surrounding sections: they run five to thirty-five lines, median about seventeen.
